profile_text.body:
Wipro is a public company whose own site describes it as a consulting-led, AI-powered technology services and consulting business. In that description, Wipro says it blends consulting and AI expertise across design, engineering and operations to accelerate business transformation and deliver what it calls future-ready technology. The company trades under the ticker WIT and its SEC filings are identified by CIK 0001123799.

Beyond that self-description, the record holds no tracked AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits for Wipro. Its presence in this reference is as a publicly listed technology services and consulting firm positioning AI as central to its offerings, rather than as a vendor of named AI products.
